cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just approve the sofa delivery. We complete the handover before discussing installation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's an installation question. One decision at a time, please: are we accepting the sofa?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The men outside have asked for a tape measure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch it. You sign the delivery sheet while I look. Signature, please; leave the measurements to me.

reason: Replace the repeated phase lecture with division of labour that gets B signing before A supplies the requested measurement tool.
